Title: Visual Studio Live Share now supports voice chat

Body.Content: Visual Studio Live Share, which allows developers to create a shared editing and debugging session, now supports text and voice chat. These public preview features help developers collaborate more effectively without needing additional chat or voice apps. With Live Share, developers join sessions from their own editors. This provides more familiarity and freedom than screen sharing. To learn more, visit the Visual Studio Live Share blog.
